newsitem.title: UK: UK card spending up yr/yr 31.2 pct in Sept - CCRG.
newsitem.headline: UK card spending up yr/yr 31.2 pct in Sept - CCRG.

text.p: The Credit Card Research Group, representing major UK credit and debit card issuers, released the following consumer spending figures for September 1996 -
CARD EXPENDITURE (in million stg) * SEP 96 SEP 95 % change
The group said September saw the highest growth in debit and credit card spending since records began three years ago.

"Consumers are choosing to pay more often for their goods with plastic in preference to cheques and cash. The September figures confirm the upward trend in card spending and show that consumer confidence has returned as the biggest increases are in non-essential sectors," Credit Card Research Group director Elizabeth Philips said.
NOTE * figures adjusted for variations in the number of processing days between months.
